title: Machakos — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Machakos: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Machakos has a population of 200,000. The capital of Machakos County, a rapidly urbanizing town near Nairobi known for its scenic hills. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 131 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
